text: Refti Men okki Alqur'aanaare nden, mofte Muhammadu ɓen ɓe Men suɓii e mofte ɗen. Hino e maɓɓe tooñirɓe ko'e-mun faggitagol harmuɗi e selugol waɗɗiiɗi ɗin, hino e maɓɓe hakindinɗo e waɗugol waɗɗiiɗi ɗin e accugol harmuɗi ɗin, hino e maɓɓe kadi adondirooɓe e moƴƴereeji ɗin, duŋayee Alla; ɓe waɗa waɗɗiiɗi ɗin, ɓe tertoo harmuɗi e añaaɗi ɗin. Ko jantaa koo, ko ɗum woni ɓural mawnungal, ngal sugu mun alaa e ɓural.
